description: Package vulnerability check. Takes an ecosystem, name and optional version, a purl, or up to 25 packages (npm, PyPI, Go, crates.io, Maven, RubyGems, NuGet and more); returns known OSV.dev advisories with GHSA and CVE ids, severity, CVSS score, fixed versions, a malicious-package flag and the lowest version that clears them where known. Use to screen dependencies. Typical response under 2 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.0099 (USDC, x402).

ecosystem.description: Any case, or an alias such as pip or golang; with packages, the items' default.

name.description: As its registry spells it, such as lodash or @angular/core.

packages.description: Or up to 25: lodash@4.17.15, npm:lodash@4.17.15 or purl strings, or objects like the single form.

purl.description: Or a package URL, such as pkg:npm/lodash@4.17.15.

version.description: Such as 4.17.15; leave out to list every advisory.

name: quantagentshop_package_vulns
title: Package vulns
